items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: They had Tebido and the band from Donner from there.

ctx.x: Well, they have, do they have a pretty big, uh, celebration up there for carnival too?
Yeah, they have, they have about five or six floats. They do? Mm-hmm. Used to have two bands. Yeah. They had Tebido and the band from Donner from there.
